title: Chapter 196: Swaying
html:
“If you’ve done nothing wrong, you have nothing to fear. Ultimately, you used Xu Zhenzhen to make money.”

Chen Ge understood now. Tian Teng Medical School had invented a ghost to create atmosphere and inadvertently summoned the real thing.

“Stop, don’t come any closer!” the woman screamed, but it was immediately swallowed by the male screaming that continued to pour out of the recorder.

” So painful! So painful!”

The voice rang out again, and all three people in the room froze.

“Brother Lin, am I imagining things?” The woman’s arm trembled. “Did that voice leave the recorder?”

The man was equally stunned. He was certain the latest scream had not come from the machine. Both actors stared past Chen Ge, trembling, and their reaction unsettled him. “Is something behind me?”

He reached into his pocket to curl his fingers around the ballpoint pen, and the muscles in his legs tensed.

“Not behind you…” As they answered, the actors retreated to the corner of the corridor, maintaining a distance of three meters from Chen Ge.

“If it isn’t behind me, why are you retreating?” Chen Ge asked through clenched teeth. They were quick to abandon him when trouble appeared. At his Haunted House, whether the threat was real or staged, he always took the lead.

” So painful, so painful…”

Then something even more frightening occurred: the voice’s source moved through the room.

It advanced as though a wounded man were dragging his shattered body across the floor.

After it disappeared for two seconds, the man’s voice suddenly appeared before the woman!

” Pain, so painful!”

The woman’s scream nearly shattered Chen Ge’s eardrums. Without looking back, she fled down the corridor.

“Ah Rui!” The man pressed himself against the wall, afraid to move. He had been frightened when they were together; now she had abandoned him. Chen Ge lifted the recorder. Its play button glowed like a red eye, and the tape still turned, yet the voice had escaped into the corridor.

It has left the tape?

Drawing on past experience, Chen Ge estimated the Baleful Specter’s strength. Lingering spirits and the weakest Baleful Specters could not leave their vessels; Xiaoxiao, for example, never left her rag doll. Stronger entities such as the mirror ghost and Pen Spirit could emerge briefly but had to return soon.

Above them were the lanky monsters from the Third Sick Hall. Though they usually perched on human shoulders, they could survive independently.

Red Specters were naturally the most powerful. They required no vessel and were, in effect, “true” ghosts.

The thing inside the tape should be between Pen Spirit and the thin monster.

The man’s agonized screams echoed everywhere. He seemed to have no target, ignoring both the actor frozen against the wall and the woman fleeing down the corridor.

This ghost acted very curiously like he was looking for something.

All the screams talked about pain. What happened to him before he died?

Ever since winning the weeping tape, Chen Ge had wanted to hear its Baleful Specter; communication was the easiest way to understand a ghost. Without a working recorder, he had never had the opportunity. This was effectively their first meeting.

” So painful, so painful…” The man’s voice stopped inside the corridor before slowly moving toward the Haunted House’s entrance.

Did he find something?

Chen Ge’s eyes suddenly glowed. The tape ghost probably had found the real ghost hiding inside the Haunted House!

The realization struck Chen Ge. Grabbing the recorder, he hurried from the room. The actor heard the voice receding and shouted into the staff chat, “The ghost is heading toward you! Run! Get out through the entrance!”

The actors near the entrance had not been overly concerned at first, but his panic quickly spread to them. He had no reason to play such a cruel trick on his own coworkers.

“Quick! Run! The thing is coming your way!”

After sending the warning, the man fled in the opposite direction from the Baleful Specter without waiting for a reply.

“What good will shouting do?” Chen Ge followed the Specter from two or three meters away. As he passed the cart outside the nursery, the petite actress emerged from the chamber of fake organs. The instant she opened the door, the Baleful Specter screamed, ” So painful!”

The gut-wrenching cry erupted beside her. She stared into the empty corridor, stumbled backward over a prop, and fell into the pile of organs. “Who’s there? Show yourself!”

Her small voice was choked with tears. She held her phone and asked for help in the employee chat group, but there was no reply.

” So painful! So painful!”

The Baleful Specter’s voice entered the room. The girl heard the screams but saw no one, and tears ruined her makeup.

Nothing appeared. The girl burrowed deeper into the mannequins, piling them over herself in an attempt to disappear. Following close behind the Specter, Chen Ge entered and stared in astonishment at what she was doing.

Chen Ge yanked the girl out from the pile and said, “Inform your people to leave through the entrance.”

The warmth of Chen Ge’s hand brought her back to her senses, and she stumbled away. The Baleful Specter did not pursue her. It searched the room, then entered the autopsy room, confirming Chen Ge’s suspicion that it sought something specific.

Gears turned in the corridor as the staff opened escape routes. The girl had warned the others, and everyone was evacuating. Chen Ge was probably the only living person left inside.

Let me see exactly what you’re searching for…

Chen Ge held the ballpoint pen and the tape recorder as he followed the voice to the entrance of Tian Teng Medical School.

A green light flickered in the narrow corridor, magnifying its menace. At the far end, the desiccated “female corpse” swayed gently from side to side.

“So painful…”

The Baleful Specter’s cry stopped beside the hanging figure. Chen Ge approached and felt a tendril of fear curl around his heart.

Earlier, while helping the actor from the box, he had felt something brush the back of his head. When he turned, he found this “female corpse” swaying behind him.
